title: Contract changelog/README lost digest coverage and cloudflare contracts.mjs keeps a dead ticks-sync path
description:
4i8 deleted TestAnEditedChangelogIsRefused. contracts/CHANGELOG.md and README.md are no longer covered by any digest: only a '## <version>' heading is checked, so a past entry can be rewritten silently. cloudflare/scripts/contracts.mjs still carries the 'pinned' mode and contracts:sync, which fetch all 16 files from ticks, which ships two. cloudflare/CONTRACTS.md:35,114 still documents it. herdr-kinds.md:18 also links a heading (#the-helper-tk-herd) that no longer exists, and references_test.go ignores anchors.

ticfac run epic-6in filed this backlog tick from the finding dca8415acfcf9fbcc3aecb2f4a248b4f3c08049371035ce52d3adca3fa125180 (reported by run-epic-6in/tick-tdu/attempt-7): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/dca8415acfcf9fbcc3aecb2f4a248b4f3c08049371035ce52d3adca3fa125180.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-09-28 12:17 - ticfac run epic-6in: created by absorbing finding dca8415acfcf9fbcc3aecb2f4a248b4f3c08049371035ce52d3adca3fa125180 — a backlog tick: the done is reachable with the finding standing. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/dca8415acfcf9fbcc3aecb2f4a248b4f3c08049371035ce52d3adca3fa125180.json on epic/6in, and it says: the epic's acceptance is prose (the acceptance carries no [A<n>]-marked items, so its definition of done is prose: nothing is runnable, nothing can be pointed at, and whether a finding gates it cannot be decided — refusing to absorb rather than guessing. Mark the acceptance into stable [A<n>] items first (ticks goal-design.md, fact sheets), then decide absorption against them.), so there is no item the reporter's claim could gate and no judgement for a person to make: the finding is backlog work, filed as a tick with an owner. The reporter does not claim it breaks the build or CI, the one claim that gates a prose done
